newsitem.title: POLAND: Daiwa rates Polish Forte as long-term buy.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa rates Polish Forte as long-term buy.

text.p: Daiwa Europe Ltd rated Polish furniture producer Forte SA as a long-term buy, stressing the firm had the cheapest product range on the market and its brand recognition was high, Daiwa said in its December report.
It also pointed out Forte's well developed distribution network and well structured production line.
It said that among the company's weaknesses were the expected reduction of Forte's net profit, due to the ending of its tax exemption period.
Forte closed at 11.1 zlotys on Monday.
